post.headline: Why millets suit dryland farming
post.summary: Millets can grow on arid lands with minimal inputs and are resilient to changes in climate.
post.caption:
Why millets suit dryland farming

Millets can grow on arid lands with minimal inputs and are resilient to changes in climate.

Why it matters: this is a millet-specific fact worth understanding.

Source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) (2022-12-06)
